user.title: Sign in to your Decathlon account
user.description:
1. [Open the Decathlon sign-in page]({login_url}) (new tab) and sign in (e-mail + code, or Apple/Google).
2. At the end, a **"Whoops! Looks like something went wrong"** page is shown: this is expected.
3. Copy the **full address** of that page (`{whoops_url}`) and paste it below, quickly (the code expires fast).
